verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only a glancing claim of global reach: Adyen says it onboards "global sellers with one integration". Managed payout schedules apply per balance-account location and currency, which implies multi-country and multi-currency support. Nothing in the pack shows a published coverage map. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported seller onboarding countries, a local payment methods coverage matrix, a local-currency settlement and payout currency map, and independent corroboration of coverage.
